items.quote: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark
items.claim: God remembered Noah and all living creatures in the ark
items.object: Noah, every living thing, all the cattle

items.quote: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged
items.claim: God made a wind pass over the earth, causing the flood waters to subside

items.quote: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained
items.claim: The sources of the flood (fountains of the deep and rain from heaven) were stopped
items.object: fountains of the deep, windows of heaven, rain from heaven

items.quote: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated
items.claim: After 150 days the flood waters receded completely from the earth
